description: This Java class `ConceptNameEditor` extends `OpenmrsPropertyEditor` to handle serialization and deserialization of `ConceptName` objects, mainly for web form interaction and compatibility with Spring framework. It provides methods to retrieve `ConceptName` objects by ID or UUID via the OpenMRS API context.

classes.name: ConceptNameEditor
classes.description: A property editor for serializing and deserializing ConceptName objects, integrating with Spring and supporting lookup by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptName object by its ID using the ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptName object by its UUID using the ConceptService.
